applicability.rationale: React presentation and existing controller admission are ordinary deterministic behavior. C-6 requires actual manual visual evidence; C-7 is a later controller delivery obligation. Neither is a model prototype or an automatic approval.
Retained task first. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: An actual controller task in the checkout-local runtime; fixture variants include running, blocked and pending acceptance.
cases.when: Open the dashboard before entering a request.
cases.then: Current recorded task status and all six stages precede request setup; empty/error states make no invented task.
cases.forbidden: A fixture screenshot alone is not retained-task acceptance.
counterexamples: Fixture-only demo labeled as a real retained run; six green stages inferred from process exit.

applicability.rationale: Stage evidence isolation. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: Two tasks, different stage routes, a failed attempt followed by success, stale recovery and a stage without receipts. Include a recognized current stage, an unrecognized current-stage value, configured routing defaults without recorded routes, and task-wide links without stage provenance.
cases.when: Select each stage by pointer, Tab and Enter/Space; refresh the snapshot and switch tasks.
cases.then: Only selected task/stage evidence is shown under UI-E1; history remains available and missing fields are explicit; selection persists per task on refresh. Initially select the recognized recorded current stage, otherwise the first stage. UI-E1 sections appear in this exact order: task/stage identity and recorded state; recorded provider/model; artifacts; tests and proof/receipts; attempt history. Task-wide links without stage provenance appear only in the separately labeled task-evidence subsection. A missing recorded route remains not recorded even with configured defaults. A receipt path or recorded pass is labeled as recorded evidence, never verified contents or a newly executed check. Assert the captured mutation-request list stays empty for all stage selections.
cases.forbidden: No route fallback from another stage or task; no selection-triggered dispatch.
counterexamples: Review route shown for QA; missing tests shown as passed; old failure erased.
Unrecognized current stage preselects QA instead of the first stage.
Task-wide link assigned to selected stage; configured default substituted for absent recorded model.
A recorded pass or receipt path rendered as newly run or verified evidence; selection sends mutation.
Attempt history precedes identity or stage sections omit the UI-E1 order.

applicability.rationale: Admission boundaries. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: Completed, branchless, running, pending-question, stale and exhausted task fixtures with captured network requests. Include an unknown or unsupported recorded next-action value.
cases.when: Inspect and attempt available existing controls; answer an admitted pending question.
cases.then: Existing authorization bindings and disabled rules remain; stage selection sends no mutation; denied work has no dispatch; questions use existing controls. Unknown or unsupported next actions render explanatory read-only text, no invented execution control, and no captured mutation request.
cases.forbidden: No grant, completion, budget reset or worker start implied by display or question answer.
counterexamples: Completed task Resume enabled; branchless task repair; answer recorded as gate pass.
An unrecognized next-action token becomes an enabled button or dispatches a mutation.

applicability.rationale: Intake journeys. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: Disposable Markdown and qualified GitHub fixtures with missing choices and held requests.
cases.when: Preview, reveal and answer missing choices, prepare, and explicitly execute; hold intake and operations requests in each direction.
cases.then: Details start collapsed and disclose missing choices; preview identity and zero provider calls until explicit execution persist; each side locks the other.
cases.forbidden: No preview/preparation execution or request switching during a busy operation.
counterexamples: Prepare dispatches workers; operation runs while intake source remains editable.

applicability.rationale: Responsive keyboard and build. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: Representative long-path, missing, failed, running, completed, read-only and question states in the rebuilt distribution.
cases.when: Run model and browser assertions at 1440x1000 and 390x844, keyboard every stage and disclosure, and build production assets.
cases.then: Stage buttons expose aria-pressed with one selected; Tab order and Enter/Space work; focus remains visible and stable on refresh; no horizontal page overflow or console errors; committed generated assets match build. At both viewport sizes, measure stage/action control bounding boxes and assert height >=44 CSS pixels. Calculate foreground/background contrast from resolved computed colors, including composed backgrounds: normal text >=4.5:1, large text and control boundaries >=3:1. Assert visible status text expresses each state without depending on color.
cases.forbidden: No clipped essential evidence or hidden focus; no new framework.
counterexamples: Mobile long model name expands page; focus disappears on polling; committed bundle renders old stage list.
A 36px stage or action button fails size checks.
Normal text at 3:1 or a control boundary at 2:1 fails contrast checks.
A status badge with color and no state text fails.

applicability.rationale: Upstream AC-5 explicitly requires visual inspection; layout quality and real retained-task acceptance require operator observation, pending until actual testimony.

cases.given: Rebuilt candidate, real retained controller task and representative fixture states with provenance separated.
cases.when: Operator visually inspects desktop/mobile layout, contrast, focus, evidence hierarchy and retained task before setup.
cases.then: Operator records exact revision, widths, observed result and evidence for upstream instruction: Rebuild committed distribution assets and visually inspect representative states. Acceptance remains pending until actual testimony.
cases.forbidden: Screenshots or author assertions cannot replace operator acceptance; no fabricated attestation.
counterexamples: Synthetic manual testimony copied into real task; visual approval inferred from successful build.

manual_acceptance.authorization: Authoritative issue 138 AC-5: Rebuild committed distribution assets and visually inspect representative states.
manual_acceptance.procedure: Inspect rebuilt candidate at 1440x1000 and 390x844 with a real retained controller task before request setup; inspect running, failed/historical, missing, completed, read-only and pending-question states, keyboard focus, contrast and overflow. Record revision, evidence references and actual observations through existing manual acceptance; do not invent an attestation.

applicability.rationale: Controller delivery obligations. Ordinary UI/controller assertions or bounded later-stage/manual evidence obligations; no model behavior is being prototyped.

cases.given: Controller-owned retained stage ledger for this task; all required gates and publication initially pending.
cases.when: Later controller runs canonical Product, Adversarial, Implementation, Review, Drift and QA, then prepares reviewed branch/PR.
cases.then: Actual stage receipts, relevant RED/final proof, failed attempts, limitations and reviewable branch/PR are retained; failed/unknown gates block completion; maximum three in-scope repairs per failing gate.
cases.forbidden: Product cannot execute later stages, recursively invoke factory, merge, deploy, reset budgets or attest pending acceptance.
counterexamples: Six synthetic receipts relabeled live; QA skipped; fourth repair after exhausted allowance.
